name: Sander Jonti
title: Autarch of Lingane
education: Imperial Realpolitik, Naval Tactics, and Subversive Intelligence
canonical_traits: Cultured, handsome, eloquent, and commanding presence
Presents himself as the ardent champion and financial patron of anti-Tyrann rebels
Ruthlessly pragmatic, eliminating allies the moment they rival his political supremacy
Secretly orchestrated the arrest and execution of the Rancher of Widemos
Plots to supplant Tyranni rule with his own autocratic empire over the Nebular Kingdoms

psychological_drivers.primary_goal: Seize the secret rebellion coordinates, destroy the Tyrann fleet, and crown himself Emperor of the Nebular Kingdoms
psychological_drivers.vulnerability: Arrogant overconfidence in his ability to deceive everyone simultaneously
psychological_drivers.growth_arc: Does not achieve moral redemption; his trajectory is a descent into paranoid fury as his duplicity is methodically exposed

metaopinions.canonical_stance: Argued that the Nebular Kingdoms need a strong unified master rather than democratic chaos.
metaopinions.exploratory_metaopinion: Jonti genuinely believes representative democracy is an infantile delusion that collapsed Earth into radioactive ruin. In his world-view, an enlightened, ruthless autarch is the only barrier against galactic anarchy.

metaopinions.topic: The Rancher of Widemos as a Threat
metaopinions.canonical_stance: Claimed grief over the Rancher's execution while blaming Rhodian betrayal.
metaopinions.exploratory_metaopinion: The Rancher was too charismatic, honorable, and beloved across fifty worlds. Had the rebellion succeeded under Widemos, Jonti would have remained a second-tier planetary lord. Removing Widemos was a calculated necessity for Jonti's ascension.

metaopinions.canonical_stance: Publicly denounced Tyranni as barbarians while quietly negotiating back-channel concessions.
metaopinions.exploratory_metaopinion: Jonti respects Aratap more than any other person in the galaxy. He perceives Aratap as the only fellow adult playing real chess on a board full of aristocratic children.

relationships.biron_farrill: Regarded as a useful pawn to be manipulated, directed at Rhodia, and disposed of when expendable
relationships.simok_aratap: Dreaded nemesis and intellectual peer; a lethal game of mutual entrapment
relationships.artemisia_hinriad: Desires her both as a dynastic trophy to legitimize his claim over Rhodia and for her sharp mind
relationships.gillbret_hinriad: Tolerates him solely as an astronavigational key to unlock the Horsehead Nebula coordinates
relationships.hinrik_hinriad: Disdains him as an impotent puppet, completely underestimating the Director
